data.name: Tip_bench_press
data.value: Shoulder blades squeezed, feet planted, lower the bar to mid-chest and press up slightly back over the shoulders.

data.name: Tip_incline_bench_press
data.value: Bench at 30 to 45°, bar to the upper chest, elbows a little under the bar, never flared out wide.

data.name: Tip_dumbbell_bench_press
data.value: Lower the dumbbells to the sides of the chest with a full stretch, then press up and slightly together.

data.name: Tip_incline_dumbbell_press
data.value: Bench at 30°, wrists stacked over elbows, control the way down and stop just before the dumbbells touch.

data.name: Tip_dumbbell_fly
data.value: Elbows slightly bent and fixed, open the arms like hugging a tree, stop when the chest is stretched.

data.name: Tip_cable_crossover
data.value: Lean slightly forward, bring the handles together in an arc in front of the chest and squeeze for a second.

data.name: Tip_chest_press_machine
data.value: Handles at chest height, back against the pad, press without locking the elbows and come back slowly.

data.name: Tip_push_up
data.value: Body straight from head to heels, hands a little wider than the shoulders, chest close to the floor.

data.name: Tip_dips
data.value: Lean forward to work the chest, go down until the shoulders are level with the elbows, no lower.

data.name: Tip_deadlift
data.value: Bar against the shins, back flat, push the floor away with the legs and keep the bar close to the body.

data.name: Tip_barbell_row
data.value: Hinge until the torso is almost flat, pull the bar to the belly button and squeeze the shoulder blades.

data.name: Tip_dumbbell_row
data.value: Knee and hand on the bench, back flat, pull the elbow towards the hip rather than straight up.

data.name: Tip_pull_up
data.value: Start from straight arms, pull the chest towards the bar without swinging, come down under control.

data.name: Tip_chin_up
data.value: Palms facing you, shoulders down and back, pull until the chin passes the bar.

data.name: Tip_lat_pulldown
data.value: Chest up, pull the bar to the top of the chest with the elbows going down, never behind the neck.

data.name: Tip_seated_cable_row
data.value: Back straight, pull the handle to the belly, shoulders back, and let the arms stretch out fully.

data.name: Tip_back_extension
data.value: Hips on the pad, go down with a flat back and come up until the body is in line, not beyond.

data.name: Tip_overhead_press
data.value: Glutes and abs tight, press the bar straight up and move the head through once it passes the face.

data.name: Tip_dumbbell_shoulder_press
data.value: Seated with the back supported, dumbbells at ear height, press up without banging them together.

data.name: Tip_lateral_raise
data.value: Light weight, elbows slightly bent, raise to shoulder height leading with the elbows, no swinging.

data.name: Tip_front_raise
data.value: Arms almost straight, raise in front up to eye level and lower slowly.

data.name: Tip_rear_delt_fly
data.value: Bent forward, open the arms to the sides with the elbows slightly bent, thinking of the back of the shoulders.

data.name: Tip_face_pull
data.value: Rope at face height, pull towards the eyes, elbows high, and turn the hands out at the end.

data.name: Tip_shrug
data.value: Shoulders straight up towards the ears, hold one second, without rolling them.

data.name: Tip_barbell_curl
data.value: Elbows pinned to the sides, curl without leaning back and lower all the way.

data.name: Tip_dumbbell_curl
data.value: Turn the palm up as you lift, squeeze at the top, and lower slowly.

data.name: Tip_hammer_curl
data.value: Thumbs up the whole way, elbows still, one arm after the other or both together.

data.name: Tip_triceps_pushdown
data.value: Elbows tight against the body, push down until the arms are straight, only the forearms move.

data.name: Tip_skull_crusher
data.value: Upper arms vertical, lower the bar towards the forehead by bending only the elbows.

data.name: Tip_overhead_triceps_extension
data.value: Elbows pointing up and close to the head, lower the dumbbell behind it and extend fully.

data.name: Tip_close_grip_bench_press
data.value: Hands shoulder-width apart, elbows along the body, bar to the lower chest.

data.name: Tip_squat
data.value: Feet shoulder-width apart, knees following the toes, go down until the thighs are parallel, back straight.

data.name: Tip_front_squat
data.value: Bar on the front of the shoulders, elbows high, torso upright all the way down.

data.name: Tip_leg_press
data.value: Feet in the middle of the platform, lower until the knees reach 90°, never lift the lower back.

data.name: Tip_romanian_deadlift
data.value: Knees slightly bent, push the hips back with a flat back, until you feel the hamstrings stretch.

data.name: Tip_lunge
data.value: Big step forward, back knee towards the floor, torso upright, push through the front heel.

data.name: Tip_bulgarian_split_squat
data.value: Back foot on the bench, go straight down on the front leg, knee in line with the foot.

data.name: Tip_leg_extension
data.value: Back against the pad, extend the legs fully, hold one second and lower slowly.

data.name: Tip_leg_curl
data.value: Hips pressed against the pad, bend the knees as far as possible without arching the back.

data.name: Tip_hip_thrust
data.value: Upper back on the bench, push through the heels and squeeze the glutes, chin tucked, ribs down.

data.name: Tip_calf_raise
data.value: Full range: heels low to stretch, then as high as possible on the toes, pause at the top.

data.name: Tip_goblet_squat
data.value: Kettlebell held against the chest, elbows between the knees at the bottom, torso upright.

data.name: Tip_plank
data.value: Forearms under the shoulders, body in one straight line, glutes and abs tight, keep breathing.

data.name: Tip_crunch
data.value: Lift the shoulders off the floor by rolling the spine, without pulling on the neck.

data.name: Tip_hanging_leg_raise
data.value: Hang still, raise the legs by tilting the pelvis, without swinging.

data.name: Tip_cable_crunch
data.value: Kneeling, rope by the head, roll the spine down towards the knees, hips still.

data.name: Tip_ab_wheel
data.value: Roll forward while keeping the lower back rounded slightly, go only as far as you can come back.

data.name: Tip_running
data.value: Short quick steps, relaxed shoulders, at a pace where you can still talk for easy runs.

data.name: Tip_rowing_machine
data.value: Legs, then back, then arms; on the way back, arms, then back, then legs.

data.name: Tip_cycling
data.value: Saddle high enough for an almost straight leg at the bottom, smooth cadence around 80 to 90 rpm.

data.name: Tip_jump_rope
data.value: Small jumps on the balls of the feet, wrists turning the rope, elbows close to the body.
